summary: Image decoding tests and handling were strengthened for robustness and telemetry: PNG CRC errors in critical chunks are now treated as recoverable so already-decoded rows are preserved, libjpeg-turbo is used to scale during JPEG downscaling to save decode cost, and new gtests and JPEG XL telemetry help catch crashes and failure modes. These changes make image decoding more fault-tolerant and improve visibility into when modern formats like JPEG XL fail.
